question: _____ is the physical network of computers all over the world.
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Internet.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The full name of the Internet is **International Network.**
 
• The Internet is a globally connected network system that is used to exchange information from one computer to another through using the **TCP/IP (Transmission Control Protocol/ Internet Protocol).**
 
• Due to the utility of the internet, this era is called the **era of communication revolution.** 
 
• America's **Vint Gray Cerf** is called the father of the Internet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Web Browser-**

 
 
• A web browser is a software application for accessing information on the **WWW (World Wide Web).**
 
• he commonly used web browsers including **Google Chrome, Edge, Mozilla Firefox,** etc.
 
 
 
• **Laptop**-
 
 
• Laptop computers, also known as notebooks, are portable computers that you can take with you and use in different environments.
 
• **Osborne 1,** the first commercially successful portable computer (Laptop).
 
• Laptop is invented by **Adam Osborne**.
 
 
 
• **Server**-
 
 
• A server is a computer, equipped with specific programs and /or hardware, to enable it to offer services to other computers (clients) on its network (connected to it).
 
• There are different types of servers: web servers, file servers, application servers, print servers, etc.
